name: Private-pay non-medical home care agency — central DuPage (Wheaton/Glen Ellyn/Lombard/Downers Grove)
summary: Independent IDPH-licensed home services agency, private pay only (no CCP/Medicaid), founder as agency manager and referral seller; dementia and hospital-to-home focus. Customers = active clients; recurring revenue = weekly hours x bill rate. Direct caregiver labor (wages + payroll load) is in gross margin; office roles are capacity-triggered staff.
evidence_notes: Bill rate: CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2025 Illinois median for non-medical in-home care $36/hr [C, DD-S006]; Home Instead 2024 national ~$33/client-hour [B, WS18-S005]; CCP Medicaid $30.80/hr [A, WS18-S020]. No Chicago-metro or DuPage private-pay median retrieved (MISSING).

Wages: Illinois personal care aide median $18.30/hr, Chicago $18.36, 90th pct $20.43 [C, C6-S024]; Illinois minimum wage $15.00, overtime after 40 h/week [A, DD-S008]. Base wage $19/hr is an assumption (E) above the median to recruit.

Gross margin: A Place At Home Illinois outlets 42.1% and 52.3% gross profit after direct labor; system median ~51% [B, C6-S022]; Addus (Medicaid-heavy) 32.8% [B, WS04-S004]. Independent base 37% derived from $19 wage x ~1.18 payroll load (FICA, unemployment, workers' comp 1.2-3.5 per $100 [D, DD-S009], Illinois paid leave) + ~3% non-billable time (E).

Ramp benchmark: A Place At Home 2025 cohort medians $329k (12-24 months), $671k (25-36), $1.50M (37-48) [B, C6-S022]. Model base year-3 revenue is checked against the 25-36-month franchise median (an independent without brand should not beat it).

Licensing: IDPH Home Services Agency licence $1,500/yr; no manager credential; worker training 10 h initial + 10 h annual; supervisor/trainer needs 2 years' experience; provisional licence valid 240 days [A, C6-S015..S021, WS04-S027].
Client churn (6%/month base), hours/client (18 h/wk base), inquiry volume and conversion are E — no public data found.
Founder draw $4,000/month from month 13 (cross-model convention); operating profit is before owner compensation.
Peak funding including the $4,000/month draw is the capital-at-risk figure; without any owner draw the base-case peak is ~$140k (computed separately in the deep dive).

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: IDPH targets ~90-day decision on provisional licence (WS04-S027); +1 month for insurance, policies, trainer hire (E).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Families in crisis start within days (Stage A/C); referral-source trust is modelled through founder ramp.
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified family inquiries/month the founder's referral network generates at full pace (E). Calibrated so base year-3 revenue sits near, not above, A Place At Home's 2025 25-36-month franchise median ($671k, B, C6-S022) given ~28 months of operation by year-end 3 and no brand.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Assessment -> start of care; families usually decide within days.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Community liaison hired month 18; starts/month assumption.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Word of mouth and repeat referrals from satisfied families/partners.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Client tenure MISSING; clients end on death, facility move, recovery or switching. 6%/mo = ~17-month average tenure.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: hours/week x 4.33 x bill rate: cons 15h x $34; base 18h x $36 (IL 2025 median, DD-S006); opt 20h x $38. Hours per client E.
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Illinois CCP and Addus IL rate +3.9% for 2026 (WS04-S004); private-pay escalator assumed 3%.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: APAH IL outlets 42-52% GP after direct labor (C6-S022); Addus 32.8% (WS04-S004); derived $19 wage x 1.18 load + 3% non-billable at $36 = ~36%.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Card/ACH processing ~1% blended + caregiver recruiting ads, fingerprint background checks, paid onboarding training ~2.5%.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Referral-partner lunches/in-services, collateral, local search ads per start of care.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website/SEO, Google Business Profile/LSA, print, community events.
drivers.dso_days__source: Private pay billed weekly with card/ACH on file (some agencies bill in advance); LTC-insurance clients pay in arrears 30-60 days (Stage A) - conservative mixes these in.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Owner capital for cash tracking only; peak funding need is the capital-at-risk measure.

staff.role: Supervisor/trainer (2 yrs experience per 77 IAC 245.71; part-time)
staff.notes: ~0.5 FTE loaded; required trainer qualification the founder lacks (C6-S015). E.

staff.role: Client care manager (full-time supervision visits every 90 days, C6-S016)

staff.notes: Added at ~$1.8M annualized revenue; frees founder from daily operations; Stage C $85k GM + load. E.

overhead.item: Insurance: GL/professional, abuse & molestation, hired/non-owned auto, EPLI, crime/fidelity bond
overhead.notes: Premiums MISSING (E); liability insurance evidence required for licence (C6-S019).
Home/virtual office until licensed and first clients (cheapest path); IDPH office requirement not verified (MISSING). E.

overhead.item: AI tools (recruiting screening, care-note summaries, family updates)

capex.item: Formation, licence application, policies/procedures, office setup, training materials

lines.item: Payroll load ~18% (FICA, FUTA/SUTA, workers' comp, paid leave)

transactions.notes: Paid weekly by card/ACH; caregiver paid weekly/biweekly. Rate C (DD-S006), wage C/E.

transactions.notes: Short-shift premium of $2/h is an assumption; 4-h minimums common (Stage A).

transactions.notes: Volume discount to $34/h assumed; Illinois overtime after 40 h/week applies [A, DD-S008]; live-in day-rate models carry overtime/sleep-time risk not modelled here.
